messages:
Alex Chen: FYI sales just uploaded BigBank's compliance packet. They want SOC2 evidence + 7-year audit log retention. Putting this here for triage. cc @Priya Nair
Priya Nair: Can you drop the PDF link?
Alex Chen: Link: https://internal.redwood/files/bigbank-compliance-packet.pdf. Short summary: long retention ask, full request/response logs, and audit trail for admin actions.
Samir Patel: What's our current retention split hosted vs dedicated?
Jess Rivera: Hosted defaults: 90 days request logs. Dedicated: contract-configurable up to 1 year. We don't support 7 years today.
SupportBot: Ticket created: CS-4123. Priority: pending triage.
Priya Nair: This could block procurement. Recommend we mark as high priority and route to product intake.
Alex Chen: Options to propose to customer: 1) Narrow evidence scope + shorter retention, 2) Move to Dedicated/VPC with contract addendum, 3) One-off exception with surcharge & legal sign-off. Need feasibility notes and owners.
Samir Patel: Engineering quick take: tenant-level long retention requires storage tiering, export pipeline, and opt-in flags. PoC ~2-3 days, hardened implementation 2-3 sprints if we include billing and ops. Cost ballpark ~0.02 USD/GB/mo + backup overhead. Low technical risk but increases ops surface.
Priya Nair: Important: customer explicitly requested "full request and response logs for 7 years." That likely triggers data protection concerns. I'll loop in Legal (BAA check, PII risk).
Ravi Gupta: (Legal) Noted. We need to confirm whether storing customer-provided content for 7 years is permissible under our policy and applicable regs. I'll review contract terms and BAA implications and advise on acceptable scopes. Estimated turnaround: 2 business days.
Jess Rivera: For product intake we need a PRD stub: problem statement, customer impact, success criteria/launch criteria, rough effort, SLA/billing changes, and negotiation fallbacks. I'll produce a stub and link it here.
Alex Chen: Proposed launch criteria: 1) Legal sign-off on evidence scope or exception; 2) Engineering confirms retention architecture and cost; 3) Billing flow for add-on available; 4) Customer signs amended SOW/attestation. Any additions?
Samir Patel: Add: ops runbook for lifecycle/deletion, monitoring for storage growth, and export tooling (machine-readable audit exports). Also test plan for restores/exports.
Priya Nair: I'll ask customer if they can accept "audit metadata + headers" instead of full payloads. That reduces legal surface. Also ask whether Dedicated would satisfy their procurement.
Alex Chen: Owners/ETAs: Samir -> PoC & cost numbers in 3 business days; Priya -> negotiate scope with customer by EOD tomorrow; Jess -> PRD stub by Friday EOD; Ravi -> legal guidance in 2 business days.
SupportBot: CS-4123 updated: assigned -> Priya Nair; due_date -> 2026-03-23.
Samir Patel: Once PoC done I'll paste a short engineering checklist into the PRD. Example checklist:
```
- confirm data types to retain (headers, metadata, payload)
- design storage tier (hot/warm/cold)
- cost calc per-tenant
- opt-in / contractual flag
- billing integration for retention addon
- ops runbook + monitor alerts
- export & deletion tooling
- test & DR plan
```
Priya Nair: If Legal denies full payload storage, fallback = Dedicated + contractual addendum + scheduled export deliveries for audits. I'll surface pricing sensitivity to Sales.
Jess Rivera: I'll tag the backlog item as "customer-driven compliance" and label it blocker-procurement. Tentative milestone: Q2 backlog review if contract path is feasible.
Alex Chen: Good plan. If Sales gets escalated, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
Ravi Gupta: I'll start contract review and flag any unresolvable policy blockers quickly.
Priya Nair: Update: customer replied -- open to interim solution: hosted + certified attestation + periodic exports while we scope Dedicated. Sending proposed language.
Samir Patel: Reprioritized PoC to earlier today. Will post results asap.
Jess Rivera: Drafting acceptance criteria and rollback/escape hatch for PRD now.
Alex Chen: Thanks everyone. Keeping thread closed until new updates. :white_check_mark:
